hypothesis: A bounded x * backwardDerivative correction after low-pass mixing synthesis would increase output pressure-derivative skewness below the output compressor threshold.
sourceModel: F135 procedural High with only fan and large-scale mixing noise admitted; N1/N2 zero isolate broadband behavior. This synthetic state is not an engine operating point.
method: Compare identical deterministic renders with the candidate correction enabled and strength zero. Render 2 s, measure from 0.7 s to the end, subtract the finite-difference derivative mean and compute its standardized third moment. Engine gain 0.25; the fixture's output peak was verified below 0.25 before comparing skewness.
decision: Remove the waveform correction and its unused profile parameter. Do not invert the hypothesis or claim crackle. Revisit with defined pressure sign, measurement bandwidth and source/propagation/receiver validation.
